title: Mitigating the Bias of Large Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge models on the LLMBar benchmark, which utilizes adversarial test sets (Neighbor, GPTInst, GPTOut, Manual) containing instances that intentionally pair poor instruction-following with high superficial qualities like verbosity, fluency, and formality to test if evaluators are confounded by surface-level text features.
